title: Loving the Unlovely
coreMove: The six-month love experiment tests chosen love with feedback and requests, while keeping safety and wise counsel in view.

exampleSpecs.audience: a spouse beginning a last disciplined repair attempt
exampleSpecs.stakes: The first sentence could invite feedback or restart the contempt cycle.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Begin with an openness statement instead of accusation.

exampleSpecs.audience: a counselor helping a spouse act before warmth returns
exampleSpecs.stakes: Scripture could become a slogan unless it becomes a concrete practice.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Turn Luke 6 into doing good, blessing, and prayer.

exampleSpecs.audience: a spouse who needs structure more than a burst of effort
exampleSpecs.stakes: A vague promise will fade unless the six-month plan becomes observable.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Plan the first month and monthly feedback in advance.

exampleSpecs.audience: a spouse tempted to ask for everything at once
exampleSpecs.stakes: The first good sign could become a demand if the sequence is rushed.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make one specific request after the first positive feedback.

exampleSpecs.audience: a spouse sending a request after a check-in
exampleSpecs.stakes: A text can teach a need or sound like a bill coming due.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep a specific request noncoercive after monthly feedback.

exampleSpecs.audience: a spouse checking whether the experiment is safe to continue
exampleSpecs.stakes: Chosen love can be misread as enduring harm without limits.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Keep safety and wise counsel inside the six-month love experiment.
